newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil minister sees 1997 trade deficit at $10 bln.
newsitem.headline: Brazil minister sees 1997 trade deficit at $10 bln.

text.p: Brazilian Industry and Commerce Minister Francisco Dornelles said Wednesday he expected Brazil's trade deficit to rise to about $10 billion in 1997.

Brazil last year posted a trade deficit of $5.54 billion. Dornelles said this year's expected increase would be absorbed by surging levels of foreign direct investment which, he said, would hit $16 billion in 1997.

Brazil posted a $4.7 billion deficit in the first six months of the year. Market analysts contributing to a Reuters year-end forecast BRAAN have predicted Brazil's trade deficit to be between $10 billion and $12.5 billion in 1997.
